notes.note: Titan rejects @deterministic and ArrayDef on formal parameters; both are allowed by BNF rule 469 FormalValuePar.
Omitting the keyword cannot be a violation (it simply yields an in parameter, see test_005); positive test showing inout/out semantics obtained via the keywords.
Module parameter without default value: not resolvable at compile time, must be accepted; not executed because the value is only provided by the test environment.
Only checks that the module parameter is bound with its value at the start of the test case; the failure case (no value supplied) is environment dependent and not covered.
Ambiguity: tested a listed element (parameterized const), which is forbidden under both readings.

Titan does not check that timer parameter default values are null.
Uses restriction 15.0 a) (templates only for data types): template value parameter of a record type with a default field. Overlaps with restriction l). Titan does not check it.
Titan accepts a template with a default type parameter; restriction l) forbids it.
Titan accepts a template with a component type parameter; restriction m) forbids it.
Deterministic context chosen: initialization of a global non-fuzzy (parameterized) template. Titan does not implement @deterministic checks.

Ambiguity: the default is a function call, which is not built from null/mtc/self/system under either reading. Titan does not check this.
Ambiguity: tested on a template's formal template parameter (valid under both readings), using 15.0 a) with a record type containing a default field. Titan does not check it.
